## What changed / 改动

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] Publication guard passed / 公开文件检查通过
- [ ] Full isolated tests passed / 全量隔离测试通过
- [ ] Appropriate manual checks completed or clearly still pending / 手动验收结果或待验收项已说明
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility updated / 说明和兼容性已更新
- [ ] No real capsules, keys, histories or private assets / 无真实迁移资料

## Risk and compatibility / 风险与兼容性

State any effect on old capsules, restore targets, interruption recovery and user configuration.
